label: GO step, early in episode: after a rewarded a1 trial, about to choose a1 again (rewarded a1-stay)
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass), only when the previous trial was rewarded (in_rew=1 at D1; 0 activations after unrewarded trials), and almost only when the agent is about to choose a1 (99.3% of mass; model_act=a1, policy logit strongly favoring a1, choice>8 holds 80% of mass) after a previous a1 choice (no activations after a previous a2). It is also restricted to the first ~35 trials of an episode (zero activity from trial 50 on, peak at trials 10-29), and is enriched in episodes that started with S1 good (86% of mass) and when good=S1. The only FUTURE variable is action, the agent own upcoming GO choice, which it computes at this step; no future random outcome is needed (this trial reward/transition are flat). Predicate covers 98.6% of activation mass on dev but precision is only ~0.31 (F1 ~0.47): many rewarded a1-stay GO steps early in the episode stay silent, and no history variable (prev transition rare/common, good state, value range) cleanly separates them. Strongest activations tend to follow an a1 choice that reached S2 via a rare transition and was rewarded, then a1 is repeated, but that subset is only ~17% of mass. Magnitude is tiny in absolute terms; it does not fire at D1 or D2, after unrewarded trials, or before a2 choices.
